issues: Oracle runs `python -I /work/oracle_py/run_wn.py`, a helper that is never copied into the sandbox (only oracles/<slug>.sh is), so it fails for every install — an oracle_defect
The `-I` flag also drops PYTHONPATH, which would wrongly fail an install that works through env.sh's PYTHONPATH
The steps-01 sample gives a single 6h step, so the 'autoregressive rollout' never feeds predictions back; v2 uses the notebook-listed steps-04 file (4 steps), so the goal's file name changes

The old oracle checked only file sizes and a 'WROTE' line; v2 inlines the notebook flow and checks finiteness, a plausible 2m-temperature range, nonzero ensemble spread and 6h RMSE against the sample's own target
